The '''PX-4''' was a type of [[Proton torpedo/Legends|proton torpedo]] first produced by [[Merr-Sonn Munitions, Inc./Legends|Merr-Sonn Munitions, Inc.]] during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. The PX-4 was capable of locking onto targets at an extreme range and dealing massive damage to enemy [[Starship/Legends|starships]], as it ripped through both shields and [[Armor/Legends|armor]]. The torpedo's drawbacks included a narrow lock-on targeting cone, a lengthy lock-on period, and a limited ammunition capacity for its launcher.<ref name="Starfighter" />
